# Week 9 Start/Sit Briefing -- Wednesday, 2026-11-04 (practice report run)

## Source and freshness

Using the **committed CI fixture** (`weekly-report-week-9.json`, generated 2026-11-03T17:15:16Z -- under 24 hours old, built with real FantasyPros consensus + ESPN injury data). No re-run was needed. The only live call made was `nflreadpy.load_injuries([2026])` filtered to week 9, specifically to check for a fresher Wednesday practice-participation overlay -- that is the whole reason this run exists at this hour.

**Result: no overlay available.** The week-9 injury feed held 28 rows, every one of them from **BAL and JAX** -- the two teams playing Thursday 11/5, who file earliest. None of this roster's 15 players are on either team. This roster's three flagged players -- Matthew Stafford (LAR), Drake London (ATL), Cam Skattebo (NYG) -- all play Sunday 11/8, and their teams had not filed a Week 9 practice report as of this run (21:00 UTC / 16:00 ET). Their designations and P(play) below are the fixture's, unconfirmed by any live source yet.

## Practice report -- every flagged player (first, since it's why this run exists)

| Player | Team | Designation | Wednesday practice | Resulting P(play) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Matthew Stafford | LAR | Questionable (Arm) | **Not yet filed** | 91.4% (fixture, unconfirmed) |
| Drake London | ATL | Questionable (Head) | **Not yet filed** | 90.8% (fixture, unconfirmed) |
| Cam Skattebo (bench) | NYG | Questionable (Hamstring) | **Not yet filed** | 80.6% (fixture, unconfirmed) |

Only BAL and JAX have filed leaguewide. Re-run Thursday or Friday once LAR, ATL and NYG post their first Week 9 reports -- that is normally when this resolves.

## Start these ten -- 144.14 expected points

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Tyler Shough | vs CLE | **17.00** | 97.2% | 17.49 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs DAL | **17.77** | 95.7% | 18.57 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | @ CHI | **15.90** | 95.7% | 16.62 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | vs ARI | **23.34** | 97.1% | 24.04 |
| WR | Tee Higgins | @ ATL | **15.86** | 96.9% | 16.36 |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | @ PHI | **12.55** | 95.0% | 13.21 |
| FLEX | Drake London (Q, head) | vs CIN | **15.45** | 90.8% | 17.01 |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams | @ MIA | **12.55** | 96.9% | 12.95 |
| K | Jake Bates | @ MIA | **8.09** | 98.6% | 8.21 |
| DEF | Jets D/ST | @ KC | **5.63** | 100% | 5.63 |

Bench: Matthew Stafford (QB, Q-Arm, 17.00 -- exact tie with Shough, see below), Bo Nix (QB, 15.60), Cam Skattebo (RB, Q-hamstring, 10.49), Jalen Coker (WR, 10.55), Sam LaPorta (TE, 11.95).

## Changes since Monday

Same set of starters as Monday's briefing -- no player swaps. The real CI fixture (FantasyPros consensus + ESPN injuries) replaced Monday's sandbox-degraded numbers and moved several values:

- **Jonathan Taylor +1.71** (16.06 -> 17.77), **JSN +1.15** (22.19 -> 23.34), **Irving +0.33** -- the real fixture generally likes this roster's top players slightly more than the sandbox in-house model did.
- **Isaiah Likely's edge over Sam LaPorta collapsed from 3.23 to 0.60** -- LaPorta's FantasyPros number came in well above the sandbox estimate. Likely still starts, but this is now a thin, recheck-before-Sunday margin rather than a confident call.
- **Stafford vs. Shough at QB went from a clear 1.68-point edge for Shough to an exact 17.00/17.00 tie.** Stafford picked up a new Questionable (Arm) designation, but FantasyPros' ceiling for him (18.59 if he plays) is high enough to offset the lower play probability. Shough is started here as the lower-variance option, but this is a real coin-flip -- see watch list.

## Still uncertain

- **QB: Shough vs. Stafford**, tied on expected points, waiting on LAR's first practice report.
- **TE: Likely vs. LaPorta**, a 0.60-point margin.
- **Drake London's head-injury Questionable** -- no ATL practice data yet; if he's downgraded, Williams moves up and Coker enters the lineup (~4.9-point swing).
- **Cam Skattebo (bench, hamstring)** -- not a lineup decision this week, but watch if it worsens.

Friday's final injury report should settle all four before the Saturday briefing.

## Opponent notes

- Jaxon Smith-Njigba vs ARI remains the clear top play, 5.57 points clear of the next-best starter.
- London's Questionable tag is for a head injury specifically -- a binary plays-or-doesn't risk, worth checking Friday's report directly rather than just practice participation.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 10:** Bucky Irving (RB, TB) and bench Bo Nix (QB, DEN).
- **Week 11: still a triple bye.** Matthew Stafford (QB, LAR), Jaxon Smith-Njigba (WR, SEA) and Drake London (WR, ATL) are all out the same week -- flagged on both the 10/31 and 11/2 briefings, still two weeks out, still worth a Week 10 waiver scan for a streaming WR before it arrives.

## Sanity checks

1. Ten starters total 144.14 expected points -- just above the 100-140 band, same explanation as Monday (142.46): a strong roster, not a broken pipeline.
2. Every if-he-plays number above is the fixture's `conditionalPoints` value directly -- no separate run, so there is nothing to reconcile against.

No waiver action this week: the fixture's own scan surfaces only kickers (Santos, Aubrey) tied with rostered Jake Bates at 8.09 -- no upgrade available.
